'''Scarab swarm''' is a [[monster]] which occasionally spawns when searching the [[grand gold chest]] in [[Jalsavrah Pyramid]] during [[Pyramid Plunder]]; the frequency is reduced when the [[hard Desert achievements]] have been completed. These scarab swarms are higher level and attack significantly faster, hitting once every [[game tick]] (0.6 seconds), making them much more likely to inflict poison.

==Update history==

* {{UL|type=update|update=Patch Notes: Part 2 - Combat Style Modernisation|date=2 March 2026}}
** Default base hit chances increased:
*** Magic ('weak'): 65 → 70
*** Melee ('same'): 55 → 60
*** Ranged ('strong'): 45 → 50

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (13 May 2010)|date=13 May 2010}}
** Scarab swarms in Pyramid Plunder have had their stats reduced to bring them back into line with how they were originally.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (1 February 2010)|date=1 February 2010}}
** Small scarabs have been given a death animation again.

* {{UL|type=update|update=Desert Month Finale|date=26 April 2005}}
** Added to game.
}}

==Trivia==
* The scarab swarms in [[Pyramid Plunder]] were graphically updated on [[5 June]] [[2017]]. The other variants of the monster and [[scarabs]] still use the old model.
